name: TypeORM
solves: Provides a mature TypeScript/JavaScript ORM supporting Data Mapper and Active Record patterns across PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, and more, with decorators, migrations, and relation mapping.
best_for: NestJS and enterprise Node apps that prefer decorator-based entities and Data Mapper patterns
Teams needing broad multi-database ORM support including Oracle/SQL Server
Projects that want Active Record or Data Mapper flexibility in one library
Migrations and relation-heavy domain models in TypeScript
Codebases already standardized on TypeORM repositories
skip_when: You want SQL-first type safety with a thin query builder — prefer Kysely or Drizzle
You want the lightest possible PG client — use postgres.js
You prefer Prisma's schema-first DX and generated client
Bundle size and decorator complexity are unacceptable for your runtime
